answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that vests slowly, like a glacier, instead of granting instant voting power at signup. New identities start with only tiny, rate-limited work, and trust grows only after repeated honest completions, so one operator running many fake accounts must fund and maintain each one separately. A bridge between separate reputation systems can share verified history without merging identities, while a single bad act burns an ember of that stake, making mass fakery expensive and slow rather than free and instant.
